text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A fan interaction event was coming up 
soon. Since it was left to the students' 
own initiative this time, the entire 
academy was buzzing with preparation.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
—All the tent poles have been carried 
over. Good job, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Students
text_block_list.text: Ouss!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Fufu! Let's all do our best on the big 
day!
choice_data_list: You're really fired up, aren't you!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Naturally! It's an event we worked so hard 
for! The fans and all of us need to enjoy 
it together!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daring Heart seemed particularly 
motivated, throwing herself fully into the 
preparations.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
The song we'll perform on stage is 
practically perfect. What do you all 
think?

text_block_list.name: Students
text_block_list.text:
"Hmm..." "Isn't it good enough already?" 
"I think they'll be plenty pleased with 
this..."

text_block_list.name: Timid Student
text_block_list.text: U-Um... ...Ah, sorry. It's nothing...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
It's okay! Go ahead and speak your mind 
first!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Every great accomplishment begins with a 
single idea, right? If there's something 
you want to do, the team is here to help.

text_block_list.name: Timid Student
text_block_list.text:
W-Well... since it's a live concert, I 
wondered if we could make it colorful with 
stage lights, or something...

text_block_list.name: Timid Student
text_block_list.text:
B-But when I think about procuring the 
equipment and all... it's probably way too 
late now, isn't it...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Not at all! First, just try! All we have 
to do is give it our all and see!

text_block_list.name: Vendor
text_block_list.text:
—Alright little lady, your passion won me 
over. Brace yourselves, cause I'm gonna 
give you the best light show ever!

text_block_list.name: Timid Student
text_block_list.text: I-It actually worked...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Fufu. See? Isn't it always worth a shot?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, this event is going to be 
even more thrilling! Let's both give it 
our best on the day!

text_block_list.name: Timid Student
text_block_list.text: Y-Yessir!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And then, the day of the event arrived— 
Starting with the live performance by the 
students, the event was thriving with 
tremendous excitement.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Thank you all for coming! We're taking a 
short break now, but the stage 
performances will keep going, so enjoy 
yourselves to the max!

text_block_list.name: Audience
text_block_list.text: "Hell yeah!!" "Heaaart!!!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However—amidst the fiery excitement 
engulfing the academy grounds.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
—I wonder what all this commotion is 
about.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Hmm. Is that so.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...As if it were none of her concern, 
Mejiro Ramonu simply walks onward. Before 
her sheer aura, everyone parted ways—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And instinctively, they found their eyes 
following her magnificent retreating 
figure.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
—If it's Ramonu-san, you shouldn't even 
have to ask.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: To run, of course.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
...Now then. I wonder what kind of tryst 
awaits us today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Haah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ramonu ran along the empty course. 
She simply ran—it was nothing more than 
that, and yet.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her majestic running form, exuding 
overwhelming "class," instantly captivated 
the eyes of the people who had supposedly 
been enjoying the event.

text_block_list.name: Reserved Student
text_block_list.text:
...She really is amazing... Her cheerful 
look, and that breathtaking running... I'm 
completely drawn in...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...With just a single run, she stole 
everyone's hearts right away, didn't she?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
A complete defeat—perhaps. For today, at 
least.
choice_data_list: Want to aim for that same peak?
Now I understand what a "Queen" truly is.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Of course. Naturally.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Because the throne of the "Queen" where 
she reigns— that throne is what I'm going 
to claim.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Seeing that form— how could anyone 
not yearn for it?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Every single girl fascinated by that same 
brilliance. I will defeat them all—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
And claim the one and only glorious crown— 
that will be me!
